description: Says whether a function's secret is set (never its value) and returns where the founder sets it — a secret is never typed into a chat. env "live": Live's own value, which never comes from Development; a Live function waits paused until each is set. Gemmein keeps it encrypted, sends it only to the hosts it is bound to, and the function's code never sees it.
name: function_secret
title: A function's secret (your human)
